name: Basic pension insurance (养老保险)
authority: Yunnan HRSS: employer 16%, employee 8% (https://www.yncxym.gov.cn/info/1011/286437.htm; https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28618.html Q82). Yunnan base 4,357–21,789 for pension, unemployment and injury. The base is the declared prior-year monthly average wage clamped to the bounds. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Employee basic medical insurance (基本医疗保险)

name: Housing provident fund (住房公积金)
authority: Kunming housing fund: ceiling 32,470; floor 2,170 (category I) / 2,020 for new, opened and transferred accounts from October 2025; the floor of an unchanged existing account after October is unresolved (register CN-KM05), so a base below the new floor refuses. Unit selects one equal rate 5–12% each side (昆公积金规〔2020〕2号 arts.10–14, https://www.kunming.cn/news/upload/resources/file/2024/10/12/1728062.pdf). Kunming has no supplementary fund: `housing_fund_supplementary_rate` must stay 0. Each share is rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入) separately — ordinary and supplementary alike — and the shares are then summed.

rules.refusal: Record the housing-fund contribution base (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or the first-ever / transferred worker’s qualifying month.
Record citizenship on the employment terms: a foreign or permanent-resident worker joins the housing fund only by agreement.

The declared housing-fund base is below the published floor, and the floor that governs this account is not settled by the retrieved Kunming notices (register CN-KM05); record the base at or above the floor or the agency’s written determination.

elections.label: Housing-fund contribution base (monthly)
elections.description: The prior calendar year’s monthly average wage, or the first-ever / transferred worker’s qualifying month, before the published bounds.

elections.label: First-ever fund worker
elections.description: A worker contributing for the first time pays from the second month of employment (Housing Provident Fund Regulation art.17).

elections.label: Agreed participation (foreign / permanent-resident worker)
elections.description: A foreign or permanent-resident worker contributes only on mutual agreement; nationality alone never enrols them.

name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law art.3 and art.6(1); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 — an assumption the register (CN-N43) has not closed for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: the IIT Law art.1 withholding method depends on it and no default exists.
Housing rent and housing-loan interest cannot both be deducted in one year (国发〔2018〕41号).

elections.label: First wage income of the year (STA 2020 No.13)
elections.description: The resident declared no wage income earlier this year: CNY5,000 is deducted for every month from January.

elections.label: CNY60,000 deducted from January (STA 2020 No.19)
elections.description: Qualifying continuing employee: declared by this employer every month of the prior year with that year’s wages at most CNY60,000.

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号; a non-resident’s multi-month bonus, MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28, register CN-N39 / CN-SH50). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.

elections.label: First wage income of the year (STA 2020 No.13)
elections.description: The resident declared no wage income earlier this year: CNY5,000 is deducted for every month from January.

elections.label: CNY60,000 deducted from January (STA 2020 No.19)
elections.description: Qualifying continuing employee: declared by this employer every month of the prior year with that year’s wages at most CNY60,000.

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号; a non-resident’s multi-month bonus, MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28, register CN-N39 / CN-SH50). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.

name: Basic pension insurance (养老保险)
authority: Yunnan HRSS: employer 16%, employee 8% (https://www.yncxym.gov.cn/info/1011/286437.htm; https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28618.html Q82). Yunnan base 4,403–22,017 for pension, unemployment and injury. The base is the declared prior-year monthly average wage clamped to the bounds. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

elections.label: Social-insurance contribution base (monthly)
elections.description: The prior calendar year’s monthly average wage at this employer, or a new hire’s first full month’s wage, before the published floor and ceiling. Every social-insurance scheme of this version reads it.

name: Employee basic medical insurance (基本医疗保险)
authority: Kunming Medical Security Bureau notice of 30 December 2022, from 1 January 2023: employer 7% excluding maternity (https://ybj.km.gov.cn/c/2023-02-08/4665265.shtml); employee 2% is implied by the 2% account credit, not stated (register CN-KM04, open). Medical base 4,403–22,017. Long-term care is funded from the medical funds, no extra deduction (CN-KM16). The per-head major-medical charge is not seeded: its only source is a reproduced agency notice. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Maternity insurance (生育保险)
authority: Kunming maternity rules of 17 July 2024 (https://ybj.km.gov.cn/c/2024-07-25/4882692.shtml): employer 0.9% on the medical base; the worker pays nothing. Medical base 4,403–22,017. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Unemployment insurance (失业保险)
authority: The 2025 reduction ended 31 December 2025; the 7 September 2026 county notice reports 0.7/0.3 again active but no successor instrument or start date was located (register CN-KM27): the agency-assessed rates are entity facts. Yunnan base 4,403–22,017 for pension, unemployment and injury. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Work-injury insurance (工伤保险)
authority: Employer only; industry classes I–VIII at 0.2/0.4/0.7/0.9/1.1/1.3/1.6/1.9% then the assigned float (云人社发〔2020〕14号; https://www.yncxym.gov.cn/info/1011/286437.htm), entity fact `injury_rate`. Yunnan base 4,403–22,017 for pension, unemployment and injury. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

rules.refusal: Record the social-insurance contribution base on the pension registration (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or a new hire’s first full month. It controls every insured amount and has no default.

name: Housing provident fund (住房公积金)
authority: Kunming housing fund: ceiling 32,543; floor 2,270 (category I) / 2,120 for new, transferred and reopened accounts from 1 September 2026 (昆公积金〔2026〕69号); an unchanged existing account’s floor is not stated, so a base below the new floor refuses. Unit selects one equal rate 5–12% each side (昆公积金规〔2020〕2号 arts.10–14, https://www.kunming.cn/news/upload/resources/file/2024/10/12/1728062.pdf). Kunming has no supplementary fund: `housing_fund_supplementary_rate` must stay 0. Each share is rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入) separately — ordinary and supplementary alike — and the shares are then summed.

rules.refusal: Record the housing-fund contribution base (`contribution_base`): the prior year’s monthly average wage, or the first-ever / transferred worker’s qualifying month.
Record citizenship on the employment terms: a foreign or permanent-resident worker joins the housing fund only by agreement.

The declared housing-fund base is below the published floor, and the floor that governs this account is not settled by the retrieved Kunming notices (register CN-KM05); record the base at or above the floor or the agency’s written determination.

elections.label: Housing-fund contribution base (monthly)
elections.description: The prior calendar year’s monthly average wage, or the first-ever / transferred worker’s qualifying month, before the published bounds.

elections.label: First-ever fund worker
elections.description: A worker contributing for the first time pays from the second month of employment (Housing Provident Fund Regulation art.17).

elections.label: Agreed participation (foreign / permanent-resident worker)
elections.description: A foreign or permanent-resident worker contributes only on mutual agreement; nationality alone never enrols them.

name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law art.3 and art.6(1); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 — an assumption the register (CN-N43) has not closed for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen.

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: the IIT Law art.1 withholding method depends on it and no default exists.
Housing rent and housing-loan interest cannot both be deducted in one year (国发〔2018〕41号).
